title: Krishnastami celebrations
paragraphs: Janmashtami Splendour! Montessori Sr Secondary school campus turned into a joyful Vrindavan as Prep-2 students came dressed in enchanting Radha and Krishna costumes. We were absolutely thrilled to welcome our Prep-2 parents, who actively participated alongside their children, making this cultural celebration a grand success. Thank you, parents, for adding so much warmth and enthusiasm to our festive day!

title: తెలుగు భాషా దినోత్సవం సందర్భగా అష్టావధాన కార్యక్రమం
paragraphs:
కర్నూలు ఏ-క్యాంప్‌లోని మాంటిస్సోరి విద్యా సంస్థల 50 ఏళ్ల స్వర్ణోత్సవాలు మరియు తెలుగు భాషా దినోత్సవం (ఆగస్టు 29, 2026) సందర్భగా నిర్వహించిన అష్టావధాన కార్యక్రమం అత్యంత వైభవంగా దిగ్విజయంగా ముగిసింది.
అవధాని: డాక్టర్ బులుసు అపర్ణ గారు (ద్విశతావధాన ప్రవీణ, పండిత ప్రపూర్ణ)
సంచాలకులు: శ్రీ అవధానం సుధాకరశర్మ గారు
పృచ్ఛకులు & అంశాలు:
నిషిద్ధాక్షరి: డాక్టర్ తొగట సురేష్‌బాబు
వ్యస్తాక్షరి: శ్రీ పత్తి ఓబులయ్య
సమస్యాపూరణం: శ్రీ గనుమూల మునుస్వామి
వారగణనం: శ్రీమతి పిసుపాటి నీలిమ
దత్తపది: శ్రీ జంగంగళ్ల సర్వజ్ఞమూర్తి
ఆశువు: డాక్టర్ దండేబోయిన పార్వతి
వర్ణన: డాక్టర్ కరాటీ చంద్రమౌళిని
అప్రస్తుత ప్రసంగం: డాక్టర్ జెగర్లపూడి శ్యామసుందరశాస్త్రి
ఈ కార్యక్రమంలో మాంటిస్సోరి యాజమాన్యం, అధ్యాపకులు, విద్యార్థులు మరియు సాహిత్యాభిమానులు పెద్ద సంఖ్యలో పాల్గొని సభను విజయవంతం చేశారు.

title: THE AUREATE QUILL: Celebrating Five Decades of Excellence, Creativity and Learning
paragraphs: As Montessori Group of Institutions proudly commemorates its Golden Jubilee – 50 Glorious Years of Educational Excellence, the Montessori English Club is delighted to present the first edition of its English Club Magazine, "The Aureate Quill" – From Golden Roots to Glorious Heights.

This magazine is a celebration of the institution's rich legacy, the creative spirit of its students, the dedication of its teachers, and the values that have guided generations of Montessorians. It brings together literary creativity, imagination, knowledge, expression and the vibrant voices of our young learners.

The presence of our distinguished Chief Guests makes this occasion even more meaningful. We are honoured by the presence of our esteemed Chief Guests: Mrs. Azra Javed Garu – Secretary & Correspondent, Osmania College, Kurnool; Mr. Bankin Garu – Retd. Professor in English, Gooty; Mr. Viswanath Gopalan Garu – Academic Professional, Chrysalis. Their gracious presence makes this memorable Golden Jubilee occasion even more special.

title: "Emote to Empower" — A Platform to Feel, Deal & Heal
paragraphs: Emote to Empower is a dedicated mental wellness initiative designed to help students, parents, and educators connect with their emotions, navigate challenges, and find inner peace. We believe in nurturing not just academic minds, but emotionally resilient individuals.

Dr. Kartika Lakshmi brings years of expertise in emotional guidance, counseling, and personal development. Through her structured training programs, motivational sessions, and empathetic approach, she empowers individuals to take control of their emotional well-being and live life to the fullest.

title: Independence Day Celebrations – 2026-27
paragraphs: Montessori Sr Secondary School, A-Camp, Kurnool celebrated Independence Day with great enthusiasm, patriotic spirit, and joy. The entire school campus was filled with the colours of patriotism as students and teachers participated actively in a variety of cultural and patriotic activities.

The celebrations began with the hoisting of the National Flag by our respected Director, Mr. K. N. V. Rajasekhar. The unfurling of the Tricolour was followed by the National Anthem, creating a proud and emotional moment for everyone present.

Students came dressed in beautiful and colourful traditional and patriotic attire and participated enthusiastically in various dance performances representing the rich cultural heritage of India. The NCC students presented an impressive march-past with discipline and confidence.

A special highlight of this year's celebration was the participation of our teachers in the march-past. Their energetic participation added a unique charm to the programme and inspired the students. Teachers also dressed in traditional costumes representing different states of India and presented a vibrant cultural dance, beautifully showcasing the country's unity in diversity.

The teachers delivered inspiring speeches on India's freedom, patriotism, national unity, and the responsibilities of young citizens. Their words encouraged students to respect the sacrifices of our freedom fighters and contribute positively to the nation.
